Correct cron syntax is not evidence of a run -- read the run history. (2) A session OTHER than MI-70 reads the ledger and ACTS on a row in it. A producer with no consumer is the exact shape provenance-consumer-guard exists to catch, and is how the `Claude-Session:` trailer sat unread in the first place. Record WHICH session and WHICH row.
